fixes.explanation: I can see that guess, friend, but break isn't the word. The verse says, "Consider the work of God: Who can straighten what He has bent?" (Ecclesiastes 7:13) The Teacher's point is that no one can straighten what God has bent, so we can't undo what He has made the way it is. Tell me you wouldn't hold a bent spoon and think, 'Time to smash it.' You'd look for the straightening part.

Not this time, baker. The verse says, "Consider the work of God: Who can straighten what He has bent?" (Ecclesiastes 7:13) Hiding sounds sneaky, like shoving a crooked cookie to the back of the tray and hoping nobody notices. But the Teacher's point is that no one can straighten what God has bent, so we can't undo what He has made the way it is, and hiding it wouldn't change that.
